name: 水准仪高差法高程计算器

map.由后视前视累计求待定点高程: Unknown Point Elevation from Cumulative Backsight/Foresight
map.输入已知点高程 BM、后视累计 BS 与前视累计 FS，求高程。: Enter known elevation BM, cumulative backsight BS and cumulative foresight FS to obtain the elevation.
map.📖 查看「由后视前视累计求待定点高程 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Unknown Point Elevation from Cumulative Backsight/Foresight User Guide"
map.由已知 BM 与后/前视算各点 RL。: Compute each point's RL from known BM and back/foresight.
map.附合到另一已知点时，计算值与已知值差=闭合差，限差内平差。: When bonding to another known point, the difference between computed and known is the misclosure; adjust within the limit.
map.RL=BM+ΣBS−ΣFS（或本站 RL=上站 RL+后视−前视）。: RL = BM + ΣBS − ΣFS (or this station RL = last station RL + backsight − foresight).
map.每站读后视定仪高再读前视得前点高，顺序错则整条错。: At each station read backsight to set instrument height then foresight for the front point; wrong order corrupts the whole line.
